title: flow_canonical dropped in eval-case round-trip (KDATAP-b7c3ae follow-up)
description: evalCaseToAnnotationRecord dropped flow_canonical, so accepted flows became needs_adjudication in the scoring path and data-flows recall denominator stayed 0. Fixed in PR #64: round-trip flow_canonical/flowCandidate, regression test, denominator now 158.
right_now_summary: PR #64 restores flow_canonical, adds a regression test, and sets the data-flows recall denominator to 158.
